audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's level chart said Skill on five of seven rows while the content layer and the packet both said Katarina early and Fizz late.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Katarina/Katarina/Katarina/Skill/Fizz/Fizz/Fizz and content win[0..6] matches it exactly. Katarina's early damage plus Shunpo (725 range, 12/11/10/9/8) off a landed dagger genuinely beats Fizz before 6; Chum the Waters flips it.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side moved to Katarina at 4/10, phases[5..6].side moved to Fizz, every why rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] (Lvl 3-5) cited 'Death Lotus reset threat' before she has an ultimate.
audit.why: Death Lotus unlocks at 6 on a 75/60/45s cooldown. The 3-5 threat is Bouncing Blade (625 range, 11/10/9/8/7) plus dagger-fuelled Shunpo resets.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] rewritten to daggers and Shunpo; spikes[1] now names the level 6 Death Lotus window and its two counters.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two decisive interactions were never stated: Death Lotus is an interruptible channel, and your kit carries two ways to end it.
audit.why: Riot's text makes Death Lotus a channel; the kit flags it 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it'. Chum the Waters knocks up, and Playful/Trickster's slam grounds and slows — either ends the channel, and the hop's untargetable frame means the flurry has no target at all. Playful/Trickster and Chum the Waters also carry grounding, which shuts off Shunpo. Voracity refunds her cooldowns whenever a champion she damaged dies, and Death Lotus applies Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns, carry, dos/donts and spikes now state the channel interrupt, the grounding on Shunpo, and Voracity.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interactions file claims Bouncing Blade can deny your dashes (a grounding flag on Katarina's Q).
audit.why: Riot's own description is 'Katarina throws a Dagger at the target that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground' — no grounding effect. Per the brief's rule, the description wins over a derived flag.
audit.corrected: No grounding claim written anywhere in this matchup.
